newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokio Marine shares slip in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokio Marine shares slip in morning trade.

text.p: Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd's shares fell below the 1,000 yen level for the first time in over a year on Thursday morning, brokers said.
The shares were down 10 yen at 1,010 yen at 0140 GMT, after falling as low as 994 yen earlier in the morning.
"The market is divided between losing and winning issues," a "Big Four" brokerage broker said. "Tokio Marine is in the losing group as there are concerns about the future profitability of the firm."
In December, Japan and the United States reached an agreement on how Japan should open its insurance industry to foreign competitors, sparking fears that the industry would face fierce competition.
Under the agreement, the current system of setting premiums for the non-life insurance sector, including auto and fire insurance products, will be liberalised by July 1, 1998.
